messages.subject: My first shiny app
parts:
Hi,

My first shiny app:

https://opendata.shinyapps.io/Riverfly/

This app is being used to display citizen science data collected by volunteers in Glasgow, Scotland - who are monitoring river bugs and beasties. Depending on what bugs they find and their abundance it creates a 'riverfly' score.

Previously, this was data laying around in lots and lots of spreadsheets and wasn't publicly available so hopefully this makes things more engaging.

But there's a loads more improvements needed. I may switch to using googlevis or highcharts etc for the graphs. But at the moment struggling to get ggplot to display a correct legend. I'll have another look into this, but if anyone has a quick fix that would be appreciated.

I also did a bit of an ugly fix to get ggplot to generate a chart when there is only one value to plot...among other bad practices no doubt

code is here: https://github.com/fozy81/Riverfly go fork - hopefully a useful map / leaflet implementation for people to copy

...apart from the odd shiny app uploading issue (which resolved itself after a day) - shiny server has been great and most problems were my lack of R skills. The Map did take a while....

I may host this on my own server at some point (if beta ends).

thanks,

Tim
